scenarios.name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Route 1 - Happy Path)
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request with Sales Order payload meeting {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} condition
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routes to CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping 1), sets generic headers via Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, and completes at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200
scenarios.validates: Message mapping transformation, header enrichment (Region, Country, BusinessObject, Sender, TimeStamp), and successful completion through Sales Order branch

scenarios.name: Sales Order Return Processing (Route 2 - Happy Path)
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request with Return Order payload meeting {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} condition
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routes to CallActivity_71 (Call Headers), executes Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, and terminates at EndEvent_9
scenarios.validates: ExclusiveGateway routing to SequenceFlow_113, header propagation into messageLog, and delivery to SO Returns receiver channel

scenarios.name: Router Condition Not Met - Escalation End Event
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request with payload that does not satisfy Route 1 or Route 2 conditions
scenarios.expected_outcome: Router directs message to SequenceFlow_110 (default route), terminating at EndEvent_11 with EscalationCode RoutingConditionNotMet
scenarios.validates: Default gateway branch execution, escalation event triggering, and prevention of silent message discard

scenarios.name: Exception Handling and Original Payload Logging
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request triggering an unhandled exception in processing (e.g., mapping failure)
scenarios.expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 is invoked: CallActivity_97 restores ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 logs original payload via Log_Payload.gsh attachment, terminating at EndEvent_95 (Error End)
scenarios.validates: ErrorEventSubProcessTemplate triggering, property InputPayload retention, attachment logging in messageLog, and final error state

scenarios.name: Malformed SOAP XML Inbound Rejection
scenarios.trigger: Inbound HTTP POST containing structurally invalid or malformed XML to SOAP adapter endpoint
scenarios.expected_outcome: SOAP listener rejects request immediately with SOAP 1.1 Fault containing unqualified faultcode and faultstring
scenarios.validates: SOAP adapter XML schema validation, SOAP Fault generation, and rejection before IntegrationProcess invocation

scenarios.name: Boundary Test - Missing or Null Parameterized Headers
scenarios.trigger: Inbound valid SOAP payload when externalized parameter headers (Region, Country) evaluate to empty/null
scenarios.expected_outcome: Flow executes successfully without NullPointerException in Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, logging only non-null custom header properties
scenarios.validates: Null-safe handling in custom Groovy script and property enricher resilience

import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import pytest
import responses
import requests

BASE_ENDPOINT = "http://localhost.example.invalid/cxf/Glovia_SalesOrder"
SOAP_ENV = "{http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/}"


@pytest.fixture
def sales_order_xml():
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ns1="http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound" xmlns:ns2="urn:sobject.enterprise.soap.sforce.com">
  <SOAP:Header/>
  <SOAP:Body>
    <ns1:notifications>
      <ns1:OrganizationId>00D000000000001EAA</ns1:OrganizationId>
      <ns1:Notification>
        <ns1:sObject>
          <ns2:giic_OrderTypeCode__c>YORB</ns2:giic_OrderTypeCode__c>
          <ns2:OrderNumber__c>SO-2023-99881</ns2:OrderNumber__c>
        </ns1:sObject>
      </ns1:Notification>
    </ns1:notifications>
  </SOAP:Body>
</SOAP:Envelope>"""


@pytest.fixture
def so_return_xml():
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ns1="http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound" xmlns:ns2="urn:sobject.enterprise.soap.sforce.com">
  <SOAP:Header/>
  <SOAP:Body>
    <ns1:notifications>
      <ns1:Notification>

@pytest.fixture
def unmatched_order_xml():

<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ns1="http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound" xmlns:ns2="urn:sobject.enterprise.soap.sforce.com">

@pytest.fixture
def soap_fault_xml():
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <SOAP:Body>
    <SOAP:Fault>
      <faultcode>SOAP:Client</faultcode>
      <faultstring>RoutingConditionNotMet</faultstring>
      <faultactor>ExclusiveGateway_80</faultactor>
      <detail>
        <errorDetail>No route evaluated to true</errorDetail>
      </detail>
    </SOAP:Fault>
  </SOAP:Body>
</SOAP:Envelope>"""


@responses.activate
def test_sales_order_happy_path(sales_order_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_ENDPOINT,
        status=202,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8",
            "SAP-Processing-Route": "SequenceFlow_82",
            "SAP-Header-Region": "EMEA",
            "SAP-Header-Country": "DE",
            "SAP-Header-BusinessObject": "SalesOrder",
            "SAP-Header-Sender": "Glovia",
        },
        body="<response><status>Accepted</status></response>",
    )

    headers = {"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8", "SOAPAction": ""}
    resp = requests.post(BASE_ENDPOINT, data=sales_order_xml, headers=headers, timeout=5)

    assert resp.status_code == 202
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Processing-Route") == "SequenceFlow_82"
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Header-BusinessObject") == "SalesOrder"
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Header-Sender") == "Glovia"


@responses.activate
def test_so_return_happy_path(so_return_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_ENDPOINT,
        status=202,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8",
            "SAP-Processing-Route": "SequenceFlow_113",
            "SAP-Header-BusinessObject": "SOReturn",
            "SAP-Header-Sender": "Glovia",
        },
        body="<response><status>ProcessedReturn</status></response>",
    )

    resp = requests.post(BASE_ENDPOINT, data=so_return_xml, timeout=5)
    assert resp.status_code == 202
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Processing-Route") == "SequenceFlow_113"
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Header-BusinessObject") == "SOReturn"


@responses.activate
def test_router_escalation_default_route(unmatched_order_xml, soap_fault_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_ENDPOINT,
        status=500,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"},
        body=soap_fault_xml,
    )

    resp = requests.post(BASE_ENDPOINT, data=unmatched_order_xml, timeout=5)
    assert resp.status_code == 500

    root = ET.fromstring(resp.text)
    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None

    faultcode = fault.find("faultcode")
    assert faultcode is not None and "SOAP:Client" in faultcode.text

    faultstring = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert faultstring is not None and "RoutingConditionNotMet" in faultstring.text

    detail = fault.find("detail")
    assert detail is not None and detail.find("errorDetail") is not None


@responses.activate
def test_exception_subprocess_restores_original_payload(sales_order_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_ENDPOINT,
        status=500,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8",
            "SAP-Error-Handler": "SubProcess_91",
            "SAP-Restored-Payload": "InputPayload",
            "SAP-Payload-Logged": "true",
        },
        body="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <SOAP:Body>
    <SOAP:Fault>
      <faultcode>SOAP:Server</faultcode>
      <faultstring>MappingException: Test_Mapping failed</faultstring>
    </SOAP:Fault>
  </SOAP:Body>
</SOAP:Envelope>""",
    )

    resp = requests.post(BASE_ENDPOINT, data=sales_order_xml, timeout=5)
    assert resp.status_code == 500
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Error-Handler") == "SubProcess_91"
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Restored-Payload") == "InputPayload"
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Payload-Logged") == "true"

    root = ET.fromstring(resp.text)
    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None
    faultstring = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert faultstring is not None and "MappingException" in faultstring.text


@responses.activate
def test_adapter_timeout_handling():
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_ENDPOINT,
        body=requests.exceptions.ConnectTimeout("Connection timed out"),
    )

    with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.ConnectTimeout):
        requests.post(BASE_ENDPOINT, data="<xml/>", timeout=2)


@responses.activate
def test_header_enricher_null_safe_handling(sales_order_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_ENDPOINT,
        status=202,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8",
            "SAP-Header-Sender": "Glovia",
        },
        body="<response><status>Accepted</status></response>",
    )

    resp = requests.post(BASE_ENDPOINT, data=sales_order_xml, timeout=5)
    assert resp.status_code == 202
    assert "SAP-Header-Country" not in resp.headers
    assert resp.headers.get("SAP-Header-Sender") == "Glovia"

risks.risk: Unmatched routing condition falls through to default escalation
risks.consequence: Inbound Sales Orders or Returns with unrecognized order type codes trigger EndEvent_11 EscalationEndEvent, causing order ingestion failure and potential backlog in Glovia
risks.mitigation: TC_ROUTER_DEFAULT_ESCALATION_03 verifies EscalationEndEvent behavior and ensures errors are explicitly raised rather than silently dropped, complemented by monitoring alerts on RoutingConditionNotMet

risks.risk: Message mapping failure due to schema mismatch or missing mandatory elements
risks.consequence: Test_Mapping (CallActivity_102) fails during runtime transformation, aborting the Sales Order path
risks.mitigation: TC_EXCEPTION_SUBPROCESS_RECOVERY_04 validates that SubProcess_91 catches the mapping exception, retrieves InputPayload from property, and preserves it as an attachment before terminating with an Error End Event

risks.consequence: GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy and Content Modifier 86 are orphaned in the BPMN model and not executed in the active sequence flow, leaving OrderCodeValid and OrganizationId unpopulated
risks.mitigation: TestSuite tests the active execution path explicitly, verifying headers set by CallActivity_4 and Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy while highlighting dead flow artifacts in coverage analysis

risks.risk: One-Way CXF SOAP listener connection timeout or sender retry storms
risks.consequence: Network degradation or slow downstream REST receivers can hold sender connections or trigger duplicate SOAP deliveries from Glovia
risks.mitigation: TC_SOAP_SALES_ORDER_01 and test_adapter_timeout_handling test timeout resilience, verify asynchronous 202 acknowledgment, and ensure property InputPayload retains source payload for idempotency checks

uncovered_paths: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) has no incoming or outgoing SequenceFlow connections in the BPMN process definition.
CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) has no incoming or outgoing SequenceFlow connections in the BPMN process definition.
coverage_recommendations: Connect CallActivity_86 between CallActivity_4 and ParallelGateway_74 so that OrganizationId is extracted via XPath into headers for routing rules.

Connect CallActivity_77 between CallActivity_86 and ExclusiveGateway_80 to evaluate OrderCodeValid before the Router, allowing router conditions to evaluate ${header.OrderCodeValid} = 'true' instead of unlinked script logic.
Remove orphaned activities from the BPMN definitions if their logic was superseded by CallActivity_4 and externalized routing expressions {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}}.
